name: accept_invite
html: /a Use this to accept an invitation when you have been invited to a room!

name: add_friend
html: /af <nick> Use this to add the chatter <nick> to your friends list!

name: away
html: /away <reason> Use this to set yourself as away with the reason <reason>!

name: ban
html: /ban [-i] <nick or IP> [reason]VIPUse this to permanently ban the chatter <nick> (or an IP) from the chat! (Using wildcards can extend the ban to additional chatters or IPs. With the flag -i an IP is banned, but in this case the exact nickname is required and the chatter must be present!)

name: ban_timed
html: /ban -t[i] <duration> <nick or IP> [reason]Guest-VIPUse this to ban the chatter <nick> (or an IP) from the chat for <duration> seconds! (Using wildcards can extend the ban to additional chatters or IPs. With the flag i an IP is banned, but in this case the exact nickname is required and the chatter must be present!)

name: beam
html: /beam <nick> <room>AdminBeams the chatter <nick> into room <room>!

name: catch
html: /catch <nick> [room]AdminPulls you and the chatter <nick> into room [room]!

name: change_rights
html: /chgrights <nick> <status>AdminUse this to change the rights of the registered chatter <nick> to level <status>! (1 for Normal; 4 for Chat Superuser; 5 for VIP; 9 for Admin)

name: change_room
html: /j <room> Use this to join room <room>!

name: clear
html: /c Use this to clear the chat window!

name: color
html: /col <RRGGBB> Use this to change your text color to the hexadecimal color code <RRGGBB> (e.g.: /col FF5599)

name: del_friend
html: /rf <nick> Use this to remove the chatter <nick> from your friends list!

name: delete_picture
html: /dp <nick>AdminUse this to remove the profile picture of chatter <nick>

name: dice
html: /dice [count] Use this to roll the dice with [count] eyes!

name: fcol
html: /fcol <RRGGBB> <RRGGBB> <text> Use this to create a color gradient in your text!

name: gag
html: /gag <nick>SuperuserUse this to gag the chatter <nick>. Repeating the command will ungag them!

name: hardkick
html: /hk <nick> [reason]VIPUse this to kick the chatter <nick> from the chat!

name: ignore
html: /ig <nick> Use this to ignore the chatter <nick> or lift the ignore!

name: info
html: /info Use this to retrieve chat distribution information and data about the VIP team!

name: invite
html: /i <nick>SuperuserUse this to invite a chatter to the room you are currently in!

name: ip
html: /myip Use this to find out what your IP is!

name: kick
html: /k <nick> [room]SuperuserUse this to kick the chatter <nick> into room <room>. If no room is specified, the user will be thrown into the Exile room!

name: list
html: /listVIPUse this to list all chatter details in the chat!

name: list_friends
html: /sf Displays a list of all your friends!

name: lock
html: /lSuperuserUse this to lock or unlock the room you are currently in!

name: mail
html: /mail <nick> <text>AdminUse this to send an e-mail to the chatter <nick>

name: me
html: /me <text> Use this to show all chatters in the room what you are currently doing!

name: moderator
html: /moderatorAdminUse this to set the moderator status for the forum; repeating the command deactivates the status again!

name: moderate_room
html: /modSuperuserUse this to put the room you are currently in into moderation mode. Repeating the command deactivates moderation mode again!

name: moderator_remove
html: /rv <nick>SuperuserUse this to revoke the voting rights of the chatter <nick>!

name: moderator_set
html: /gv <nick>SuperuserUse this to grant the voting rights to the chatter <nick>

name: nick
html: /nick <nick> Use this to change your nickname!

name: query
html: /query <nick> Start a private chat with <nick>!

name: quit
html: /q [reason] Use this to leave the chat!

name: rehash
html: /rehashAdminUse this to reload the chat configuration changes!

name: sepa
html: /sepa <room> Use this to join room <room> and lock it! (Like a private room)

name: shout
html: /s <text> Use this to shout the text <text>!

name: show_bans
html: /sbansVIPUse this to list all bans in the chat with ID and nickname!

name: shutdown
html: /shutdownAdminUse this to shut down the chat!

name: superuser_remove
html: /rsu <nick>SuperuserUse this to revoke the superuser rights from the chatter <nick>!

name: superuser_room_remove
html: /dsu <nick>SuperuserUse this to revoke the permanent superuser rights from the chatter <nick> for this room! (Room owner only)

name: superuser_room_set
html: /asu <nick>SuperuserUse this to grant permanent superuser rights to the chatter <nick> for this room! (Room owner only)

name: superuser_set
html: /su <nick>SuperuserUse this to grant superuser rights to the chatter <nick>!

name: supervisor
html: /svAdminUse this to toggle supervisor mode! (This function allows you to retrieve more administrative details in the chat)

name: system
html: /sys <text>AdminUse this to send the system message <text> to all chatters!

name: topic_private
html: /tSuperuserUse this to delete the room topic if one exists!/t <topic>SuperuserUse this to set the room topic to <topic>!

name: unban
html: /uban <id or nick>VIPUse this to unban chatters with ID <id> or nickname <nick>... (Wildcards * or ? can be used to unban multiple bans...)

name: who
html: /wc Use this to display all chatters in the chat to you!

name: who_room
html: /w Use this to display all chatters in the room you are in to you!/wc <room> Use this to display all chatters present in room <room> to you!

name: whois
html: /w <nick> Use this to retrieve the profile summary for chatter <nick> and get a link to the extended profile!

name: wipe
html: /wipeAdminUse this to kick all chatters from the chat without exception! (This command should only be used for serious problems...)
